title: Discover Turkey By Rail
description: Discover a different side of Turkey on an immersive journey that combines iconic cities, ancient civilizations, dramatic landscapes, and memorable railway experiences. From the historic streets of Istanbul to the remote ruins of Ani, the Black Sea mountains, the Hittite capital of Hattusa, and the cultural heart of Ankara, this itinerary goes far beyond the classic tourist route. Your journey begins in  Istanbul , exploring Ottoman heritage and the treasures of the Old Town before flying east to  Kars , where Russian-era architecture and the ancient city of  Ani  reveal the region’s fascinating history. Travel by train through eastern Anatolia to  Erzurum , continue to the lush Black Sea coast and  Trabzon , and discover the spectacular  Sumela Monastery . The journey then moves inland to Divrigi , home to the UNESCO-listed Great Mosque and Hospital, before boarding an overnight train toward Ankara . In Turkey’s capital, explore Anitkabir , the Museum of Anatolian Civilizations, and the city’s Roman heritage, followed by a full day journey to Hattusa , the ancient capital of the Hittite Empire. The adventure concludes with a high-speed train journey from  Ankara back to Istanbul , bringing together Turkey’s ancient past, diverse cultures, regional cuisines, and modern railway network in one unforgettable journey. Highlights include:  Istanbul’s Ottoman heritage, Kars and Ani, scenic eastern Anatolian train journeys, Erzurum, Trabzon and the Black Sea, Sumela Monastery, UNESCO-listed Divrigi, an overnight train experience, Ankara, Hattusa and Yazilikaya. This is a journey designed for travelers who want to  see more of Turkey, travel more meaningfully, and experience the country beyond its most familiar destinations.

itinerary.title: Istanbul | Ottoman Heritage & Old Town
itinerary.description: Welcome to Istanbul! Your Turkey by Rail journey begins at  1:00 PM  with a welcome meeting with your local guide. Begin with an  orientation walk through Istanbul’s historic Old Town , taking in the atmosphere of Sultanahmet and learning about the city’s Byzantine and Ottoman heritage. Continue to  Topkapi Palace , the former imperial residence and administrative center of the Ottoman sultans for nearly four centuries. Explore its impressive courtyards, royal collections and spectacular views over the Bosphorus. After the visit, enjoy some free time to relax or explore the surrounding historic streets before gathering for a  welcome dinner featuring traditional Turkish cuisine . Overnight:  Istanbul Meals:  Welcome Dinner Included:  Local guide, Topkapi Palace entrance, orientation walk, welcome dinner

itinerary.title: Kars | Russian Heritage & Ancient Kars
itinerary.description: After breakfast, take a  domestic flight to Kars , gateway to the far east of Turkey. Upon arrival, begin your exploration of this fascinating border city with Kars Castle , rising above the historic center and offering panoramic views across the city. Continue to the Church of the Twelve Apostles (Kumbet Mosque) , a remarkable 10th century Armenian monument that reflects the many cultural and religious layers of Kars. Enjoy an  orientation walk through the historic city center , discovering Kars's distinctive  Russian-era architecture . Wide streets, basalt stone buildings and the city's planned grid reflect the period of Russian rule in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. In the evening, enjoy  dinner at a local restaurant , experiencing some of the distinctive flavors of eastern Turkey. Overnight:  Kars Meals:  Breakfast, Dinner Included:  Domestic flight, local guide, Kars Castle, Church of the Twelve Apostles, city orientation walk

itinerary.title: Kars & Ani | The Lost City of Ani
itinerary.description: Today’s highlight is a journey to the  ancient ruins of Ani , one of Turkey’s most remarkable archaeological sites and once a thriving medieval capital on the Silk Road. After breakfast, travel from Kars to Ani, passing through the dramatic landscapes of eastern Turkey. Explore the atmospheric ruins with your guide, including the  Cathedral of Ani, Church of St. Gregory, Church of the Redeemer and the ancient city walls . Walk among the remains of this once-great city, situated dramatically on the edge of a gorge overlooking the border with Armenia. Your guide will bring Ani’s Armenian, Byzantine, Seljuk and Silk Road history to life. After exploring Ani, return to Kars and enjoy the remainder of the afternoon at leisure. Take time to relax, revisit the city center or discover more of Kars’s distinctive local character. Overnight:  Kars Meals:  Breakfast, Dinner Included:  Private transportation to Ani, local guide, Ani archaeological site entrance, guided exploration of Ani

itinerary.title: Kars to Erzurum by Train
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we board the morning train from  Kars to Erzurum , beginning another scenic chapter of our Turkey by Rail journey. Train journey: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM Sit back and enjoy the changing landscapes of eastern Turkey as the train travels through the dramatic highlands and mountains of the region. Upon arrival in Erzurum, meet your local guide and begin exploring this historic city, once an important stop along the ancient Silk Road. Visit the  Cifte Minareli Medrese , one of Erzurum’s most impressive Seljuk monuments, before taking an  orientation walk through Erzurum’s historic streets . In the evening, enjoy a special  traditional dinner in one of Erzurum’s historic houses , experiencing authentic local cuisine and the warm hospitality of eastern Turkey. Overnight:  Erzurum Meals:  Breakfast, Dinner Included:  Train journey Kars–Erzurum, local guide, Cifte Minareli Medrese, city orientation walk, traditional Erzurum house dinner

itinerary.title: Erzurum to Trabzon | From the Highlands to the Black Sea
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave Erzurum and travel towards  Trabzon , descending from the highlands towards the lush landscapes of Turkey’s Black Sea coast. Upon arrival, begin your exploration of Trabzon with a visit to the historic  Hagia Sophia , a remarkable Byzantine monument reflecting the city’s long history between the Black Sea, Byzantium and the Ottoman Empire. Continue to  Ataturk Mansion , surrounded by gardens and overlooking the city. Later, explore Trabzon’s lively historic center with an  orientation walk through Meydan, Uzun Sokak and the traditional bazaar streets . End the afternoon at  Boztepe , one of the city’s best viewpoints, where you can enjoy panoramic views across Trabzon and the Black Sea. In the evening, enjoy a relaxed dinner featuring  Black Sea cuisine , with local specialties such as kuymak, fresh fish or Akcaabat kofte. Overnight:  Trabzon Meals:  Breakfast, Dinner Included:  Transportation Erzurum–Trabzon, local guide, Hagia Sophia, Ataturk Mansion, city orientation walk, Boztepe

itinerary.title: Trabzon | Sumela Monastery & Black Sea Culture
itinerary.description: Today we leave the city behind and travel into the spectacular mountains surrounding Trabzon. Our highlight is  Sumela Monastery , dramatically built into the cliffs of Altindere Valley. Explore the monastery, its chapels, rock church and historic frescoes while enjoying the spectacular forested landscape of the national park. Continue through the  Macka Valley , stopping in  Hamsikoy , a traditional mountain village famous for its local cuisine and particularly its celebrated rice pudding. Return to Trabzon in the afternoon with time to relax or explore the city independently. In the evening, enjoy a  local Black Sea dinner , completing your two days in Trabzon with the flavors and hospitality of the region. Overnight:  Trabzon Meals:  Breakfast, Dinner Included:  Private transportation, local guide, Sumela Monastery, Altindere Valley, Macka Valley, Hamsikoy visit

itinerary.title: Trabzon to Divrigi | UNESCO Heritage & Overnight Train
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave Trabzon and travel towards  Divrigi , a historic town known for one of Turkey’s greatest masterpieces of medieval Islamic architecture. The highlight of the day is a visit to the  Divrigi Great Mosque and Hospital (Divrigi Ulu Camii ve Darussifasi) , a spectacular 13th-century monument celebrated for its extraordinary stone carvings and architectural detail. The site is a  UNESCO World Heritage Site  and one of the most important examples of Seljuk-era architecture in Turkey. After exploring Divrigi and its historic surroundings, enjoy some time to relax before continuing to the railway station. In the evening, board the  7:49 PM overnight train to Ankara . Settle into your cabin and experience one of the most memorable parts of your Turkey by Rail journey — travelling through the heart of Anatolia overnight by train. Overnight: Overnight train to Ankara Meals: Breakfast Included: Private Transportation Trabzon–Divrigi, Divrigi Ulu Camii and Darussifasi visit, train to Ankara

itinerary.title: Ankara | The Heart of Modern Turkey
itinerary.description: Arrive in  Ankara at approximately 10:30 AM  after your overnight train journey. Meet your local guide and begin exploring Turkey’s capital. Start with  Anitkabir , the monumental mausoleum of Mustafa Kemal Ataturk and one of the most important symbols of modern Turkey. After the visit, continue to your hotel for  check-in and some time to refresh . In the afternoon, visit the  Museum of Anatolian Civilizations , home to an exceptional collection tracing thousands of years of Anatolian history, including the remarkable heritage of the  Hittites . Continue with a walk through Ankara’s ancient past, visiting the  Temple of Augustus , an important Roman monument, followed by the  Roman Baths of Ankara , where you can see the remains of the city's Roman-era public life. After a full day exploring Ankara from its ancient civilizations to the foundation of the modern Turkish Republic, enjoy the evening at leisure. Overnight:  Ankara Meals:  Breakfast Included:  Local guide, Anitkabir, Museum of Anatolian Civilizations, Temple of Augustus, Roman Baths

itinerary.title: Hattusa | Journey into the Hittite World
itinerary.description: Today, leave Ankara after breakfast for a full-day journey to  Hattusa , the ancient capital of the Hittite Empire and one of Turkey’s most important archaeological sites. Explore the monumental ruins of Hattusa, including the  Great Temple, Lion Gate, Royal Gate, ancient city walls, and the remains of the royal quarter . Your local guide will bring the Hittite civilization to life as you discover the history of this powerful Bronze Age empire. Continue to  Yazilikaya , a remarkable open-air rock sanctuary just outside Hattusa, where impressive reliefs depict Hittite gods and religious ceremonies. After the visit, enjoy lunch featuring local Corum cuisine before returning to Ankara in the afternoon. The evening is free to relax or explore Ankara at your own pace. Overnight: Ankara Meals: Breakfast Included: Private transportation, local guide, Hattusa entrance, Yazilikaya entrance, guided archaeological visit, local lunch.

itinerary.title: Ankara to Istanbul by High-Speed Train
itinerary.description: After breakfast, board the high speed train from Ankara to Istanbul and enjoy a comfortable journey through the landscapes of central Turkey. Upon arrival in Istanbul, your  Turkey by Rail journey comes to an end at the Istanbul train station . From here, you can continue to your hotel, airport, or onward journey independently. Meals: Breakfast Included: High speed train ticket from Ankara to Istanbul

title: Sunrise Walking Tour of Istanbul With Traditional Breakfast
description: Experience Istanbul before the city wakes up on our  Sunrise Walking Tour , a peaceful and unforgettable way to discover the historic heart of the city. Start your morning in  Sultanahmet , where the streets and squares are beautifully quiet at sunrise. Walk through the historic Hippodrome and admire the magnificent  Blue Mosque  and  Hagia Sophia  in the soft morning light. Continue through the atmospheric streets of the Old City, discovering Istanbul’s fascinating history while avoiding the crowds of the later hours. After your morning walk, cross to the Asian side of Istanbul by local ferry and enjoy the city from the water as the Bosphorus comes alive. Finish your experience with a  traditional Turkish breakfast , featuring fresh bread, cheeses, olives, eggs, tomatoes, cucumbers, jams, honey, and Turkish tea. This experience combines  history, local life, the Bosphorus, and authentic Turkish cuisine —all in one beautiful morning.

itinerary.title: Sultanahmet Early Morning Walking Exploration
itinerary.description: Meet your local guide in Sultanahmet at first light. Stroll through the tranquil Hippodrome, viewing the Obelisk of Theodosius and the Blue Mosque exterior bathed in soft morning light before the crowds arrive.

itinerary.title: Traditional Turkish Breakfast on the Bosphorus Terrace
itinerary.description: Sit down for an elaborate traditional breakfast featuring artisan cheeses, warm simit breads, black and green Aegean olives, regional honey with clotted cream, menemen eggs, and freshly brewed Turkish tea with panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Historic Old Town Alleys & Hidden Courtyards
itinerary.description: Walk through atmospheric cobblestone side streets, artisan workshops, and secret Ottoman hans as the historic quarter begins its daily rhythm.

highlights: Historic Hippodrome and Blue Mosque views

title: Cappadocia 7-Day Hiking Adventure
description: Discover the magical landscape of Cappadocia on an immersive 7-day Hiking journey through hidden valleys, ancient cave churches, traditional villages, and breathtaking viewpoints. From the colorful trails of rose and red valleys to the peaceful riverside paths of ihlara canyon, this experience combines nature, culture, and local life. Enjoy authentic encounters, panoramic hikes, underground cities, Optional hot air balloon adventures while exploring Cappadocia beyond the typical tourist routes.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Cappadocia
itinerary.description: Hello. Today we will have a Welcome meeting at 6 pm where you will meet your tour guide and fellow travelers. After the briefing, orientation walk starts in Goreme Town. Welcome dinner in Goreme town. Try delicious and famous pottery kebab Meal : Dinner optional Accommodation : Ciner hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Red & Rose Valley Hike ( 10 - 12 km )
itinerary.description: Enjoy a scenic hike through Cappadocia’s beautiful Red and Rose Valleys, famous for their colorful rock formations, fairy chimneys, cave churches, and peaceful vineyard trails. Walk along winding paths and narrow canyon passages while discovering hidden chapels carved into the cliffs. Take a relaxing break at a local valley café before continuing toward the panoramic viewpoints of Red Valley, where the landscape glows with stunning shades of red and pink, especially at sunset. Hiking Distance : Approx. 10–12 km Accommodation : Tas Konak Cave Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Love Valley Hike ( 8 - 10 km )
itinerary.description: After breakfast, set out for a scenic nature trek through the beautiful Love Valley, famous for its towering fairy chimneys and unique volcanic rock formations. Walk along peaceful trails surrounded by vineyards, orchards, and dramatic canyon scenery while enjoying spectacular views of Cappadocia’s landscape. Continue toward Uchisar, the highest point in Cappadocia, passing through quiet village paths and natural valleys along the way. Enjoy panoramic views of the region and explore the charming atmosphere of Uchisar Village beneath its impressive rock castle. This easy to moderate hike offers a perfect combination of nature, local life, and breathtaking scenery. Hiking Distance : Approx. 8–10 km Accommodation : Ciner Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Ihlara Valley Nature & River Hike ( 12 - 14 km )
itinerary.description: Drive to the stunning Ihlara Valley, one of Cappadocia’s most beautiful canyon landscapes. Enjoy a scenic trek along the Melendiz River surrounded by lush greenery, towering cliffs, and peaceful nature far from the crowds. Walk through the canyon while discovering ancient rock-cut churches, hidden cave dwellings, and frescoed chapels carved into the valley walls by early Christian communities centuries ago. Along the route, enjoy relaxing riverside breaks at local cafés set beside the flowing river. This refreshing hike combines nature, history, and local atmosphere, offering a completely different side of Cappadocia. Hiking Distance : Approx. 12–14 km Accommodation : Ciner Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Pigeon Valley Hike ( 6 - 8 km )
itinerary.description: Continue with a scenic hike through Pigeon Valley, famous for its panoramic views, cave dwellings, and traditional pigeon houses carved into the cliffs. Walk along peaceful valley trails surrounded by unique rock formations and beautiful Cappadocian landscapes stretching between Uchisar and Goreme. This experience offers a perfect blend of Cappadocia’s rich history, local culture, and stunning natural scenery. Hiking Distance : Approx. 6–8 km Accommodation : Ciner Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Ortahisar Hidden Valley Hike ( 7 - 9 km )
itinerary.description: After breakfast, explore the authentic village atmosphere of Ortahisar, one of Cappadocia’s most traditional and less-visited towns. Walk through quiet stone streets, local neighborhoods, and scenic countryside paths beneath the impressive Ortahisar Rock Castle. Continue with a peaceful hike through hidden valleys away from the crowds, surrounded by dramatic rock formations, cave dwellings, orchards, and small local farms. Along the way, enjoy beautiful panoramic viewpoints and experience the untouched side of Cappadocia’s natural landscape. This easy to moderate hike offers a perfect combination of local culture, nature, and off-the-beaten-path discovery. Hiking Distance: Approx. 7–9 km. Hiking Distance : Approx. 7–9 km Accommodation : Ciner Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Early this morning, enjoy an unforgettable Sunrise hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia’s magical landscape. Drift above fairy chimneys, colorful valleys, rock formations, and cave villages while watching the sunrise illuminate the region in stunning shades of gold and pink. After the flight, celebrate with a traditional certificate and light refreshment before returning to your hotel for breakfast and check-out. Depending on your flight time, enjoy some free time for last-minute shopping, relaxing at a local café. Optional Hot Air Balloon Ride. Depends on weather forecast, it may be any available previous Day.

title: Immersive All Turkey: Culinary & Cultural Tour
description: Begin in Istanbul, where iconic landmarks such as Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, and the vibrant Grand Bazaar showcase the city’s rich history and dynamic culture. Continue to the moving battlefields of Gallipoli and the legendary ancient city of Troy. Discover the remarkably preserved ruins of Ephesus, then marvel at the dazzling white terraces of Pamukkale. Relax along the Mediterranean coast in Antalya before heading inland to explore the unique landscapes of Cappadocia. Your journey continues in Gaziantep, a culinary capital rich in culture and history. Visit the extraordinary Gobeklitepe, the world’s oldest known temple, Continue to Capital of Mezopotamia. Visit Mardin, Van & Kars city. Step further back in time as you explore these ancient settlements, then journey to Mount Nemrut for an unforgettable experience. Enjoy a rewarding hike to witness the colossal statues of the Commagene Kingdom and take in one of the most breathtaking sunset views in the region. Mardin is the hidden gem of messopotamia. Amazing meals and great history blends here. Van Lake and Akdamar church , old Armenian Capital waits you... This carefully curated journey offers the perfect blend of history, nature, and culture—an experience you will cherish long after your travels end.

itinerary.title: Gallipoli & Meyhane Food Culture

After a 4 hours short driving, We reach the site of Gallipoli's key Battlefields , Memorials and cemeteries . Reflect at an Anzac cove , Lone Pine cemetery and ChunukBair , while gaining deep insights into bravery and sacrifice of Anzac troops through expert commentary. This journey offers a respectful  and moving tribute to a significant chapter in history. Today you will experience Meyhane culture  which is a central part of traditional  Ottoman and modern Turkish social life , especially in Istanbul and coastal cities. Overnight in Canakkale Accomodation : DoubleTree by Hilton or Similar

itinerary.description: Today we will depart from Canakkale and head to Ephesus. Our first stop will be the historic site of Troy and Archeologican Museum , where you will explore the legendary ruins of this ancient city. Today at lunch , We will try Ezine cheese (Ezine peyniri)  is one of Turkey’s most famous and protected cheeses. Ezine cheese , some bread and Traditional Turkish tea is one of the best. Overnight in Selcuk Accomodation : Celsus Boutique Hotel or Similar

Explore the impressive Great Theater and stroll through the Historic Arcadian way . Marvel at the well-preserved Temple of Hadrian and the remains of the Roman Baths . Conclude with a visit to the Terrace Houses , showcasing the opulent lifestyle of Ephesus' elite. This immersive tour offers a deep dive into the rich history and architectural splendor of one of the best-preserved ancient cities. Today we have Turkish Cooking Class . Are you Ready for it ? Let cook with local chef and have a great dinner all together. Overnight in Ephesus Accommodation : Celsus Boutique Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Antalya & Pamukkale
itinerary.description: Experience the natural wonder of Pamukkale with our detailed itinerary. Start your day exploring the stunning white terraces of Pamukkale, formed by thermal mineral waters that create cascading pools. Enjoy s soak in the warm, mineral-rich waters of the thermal pools , taking in the breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. Next, visit the ancient city of Hierapolis , where you can wander through the well-preserved ruins , including the ancient theater and Roman baths . Overnight in Antalya Accommodatio n : Ruin Adalia Boutique Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Antalya & Mediterranian Sea Food Experience
itinerary.description: This morning, we begin our exploration of the Old Town with a guided city tour. Our first stop is Hadrian’s Gate , one of the most iconic landmarks of the city. From there, we take a pleasant walk to the Roman Necropolis Museum, where you will gain insight into ancient burial traditions and local history. Along the way, we’ll enjoy a taste of delicious Turkish ice cream before continuing to discover the remains of the Old Seljuk civilization settlements. After the guided visits, you will have some free time to wander through the charming streets and enjoy shopping at your own pace. In the evening, get ready for a memorable sunset dinner , the perfect way to end a day full of history and culture. Overnight in Antalya Accomodation : Ruin Adalia Boutique Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Konya - Traditional Central Anatolian Tastes
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in the afternoon, we begin exploring the city’s rich cultural heritage with a visit to the renowned  Mevlana Museum , the resting place of the great Sufi mystic Rumi. Here, you will gain a deeper understanding of Sufi philosophy, spirituality, and the Whirling Dervish tradition. We then continue to the elegant  Karatay Tile Museum , where you will admire exquisite examples of 13th-century Seljuk tile art and craftsmanship, reflecting the artistic brilliance of the Seljuk era. In the evening, enjoy a delicious dinner featuring authentic Central Anatolian cuisine at one of Konya’s well-known traditional restaurants and a perfect opportunity to savor the local flavors and unwind after a culturally enriching day. Overnight in Konya Accommodation : Hilton Garden inn Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Cappadocia & Catalhoyuk Ancient City
itinerary.description: Start with a visit to Catalhoyuk well-preserved 9.000 years old Neolithic settlement , one of the oldest urban centers. This itinerary offers a rich blend of spiritual, historical and cultural experiences in Konya and especially provides a fascinating glimpse into early human civilization and its development. We drive 3 hours to Cappadocia and most unique part of the country will welcome you. Get ready for unforgettable valley walk with your guide. it is one of the best way to start exploring Cappadocia. At dinner we will have a Cappadocia signature dish Testi Kebabi (Pottery Kebab) . Overnight in Cappadocia Accommodation : Barceló Cappadocia or Similar

Next, explore the grime Open-Air Museum , a UNESCO World Heritage Site with its rock-cut churches and frescoes. we drive 30 min. to Derinkuyu underground city is another highlight to discover. Today You eat  home-cooked food  in a real family house, not a restaurant. You will learn Local recipes, daily life traditions, Table etiquette and family Stories. Overnight in Cappadocia Accomodation : Barceló Cappadocia or Similar

itinerary.title: Gaziantep & Famous Antep Baklava
itinerary.description: Visit the world-renowned  Zeugma Mosaic Museum , home to some of the most stunning Roman mosaics ever discovered, including the iconic “Gypsy Girl.” This museum offers a fascinating glimpse into the region’s ancient past. Wander through the charming alleys of the old bazaar area, including  Bakircilar Carsisi  (Coppersmith Bazaar), where you can watch artisans at work and shop for handcrafted souvenirs. For dinner, indulge in Gaziantep’s legendary cuisine at  Imam Cagdas , one of the most famous kebab restaurants in the country. Try local specialties such as  Ali Nazik kebab ,  lamb skewers , and freshly baked  lahmacun . Overnight in Gaziantep Accomodation : Hilton Garden inn or Similar

itinerary.title: Adiyaman & Local Family Lunch

In Adiyaman, you’ll experience authentic daily life as we visit a local Kurdish family in their home. Share a traditional meal, learn about their culture, and discover the stories behind their special dishes. Afterward, we drive to Mount Nemrut to see the giant stone heads and Watch the sun set over the colossal statues of this UNESCO World Heritage Site at 2,000 m.   Overnight in Adiyaman. Accommodation : Ramada by Wyndham Adiyaman or Similar

itinerary.title: Gobeklitepe Temple & Traditional Sira Gecesi Activity

Visit the  Sanliurfa Archaeology Museum  and the  Mosaic Museum , home to the famous “Urfa Man” statue. Get ready this evening for enjoyable activity. Overnight in sanliurfa Accommodation : Hilton Garden inn or similar

Overnight in Sanliurfa Accommodation : Hilton Garden inn or similar

Then treat yourself to delicious baklava served with traditional Turkish ice cream — a perfect way to end your journey with a sweet delight. Overnight in Mardin Accommodation : Kasim Efendi Konagi Boutique hotel or similar

Explore  Dara Ancient City , an important Byzantine site, and  Deyrulzafaran Monastery , a spiritual center of the Syriac Orthodox Church. We have a reservation for one of the popular traditional restaurant. You will have Mardin's signature meals like Kaburga Dolmasi Stuffed lamb ribs filled with rice, almonds, spices. Irok ( Stuffed Kibbeh ) and more interesting foods. Before we finish our experience, do not forget to have Kurdish traditional coffee Mirra . Overnight in Mardin Accommodation : Kasim Efendi Konagi Boutique hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Van & Traditional Local Dinner

Afterwards, return to the mainland and visit the imposing Van Castle, offering breathtaking panoramic views over the lake and surrounding landscape. Overnight in Van Accommodation : Double Tree by Hilton or Similar

itinerary.title: Kars & Famous Cheese Taste
itinerary.description: Depart after delicious breakfast and Visit  Ishak Pasa Palace , an Ottoman-Persian architectural masterpiece, with views of  Mount Ararat . We will visit a cheese shop. Kars is famous for its  Gravyer cheese  (Swiss-style, nutty, aged) and rich  Kars kasar . The high-altitude pastures give the milk a unique aroma. Overnight in Kars Accommodation : Katarina Palace Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Kars Ani Ruins & Fly back to Istanbul
itinerary.description: A city where the echoes of empires still linger in its streets. Discover Kars’s fascinating blend of  Russian-era architecture, Ottoman heritage, and vibrant local culture .  This Afternoon, journey to the awe-inspiring  Ani Ruins , the once-glorious medieval capital known as the “City of 1,001 Churches.” Perched dramatically on the border overlooking the Arpacay River, Ani’s silent stone walls and towering cathedrals whisper tales of Silk Road traders, ancient kingdoms, and lost civilizations. Stroll among its hauntingly beautiful remains, from the grand Cathedral of Ani to the Church of the Redeemer, and feel the weight of history beneath your feet. We have a afternoon flight to Istanbul and Tour ends in the airport

title: Kas: Hike, Bike, Kayak & Dive
description: Explore Kas: Nature, History, and the Sea – A Perfect Mediterranean Escape Nestled along the stunning turquoise coast of Turkey,  Kas  offers the perfect mix of adventure, culture, and relaxation. Start your journey with trade two wheels for a paddle and head out on a  kayaking adventure over the sunken city of Kekova . Glide across crystal-clear waters as you pass over ancient ruins submerged just beneath the surface, and stop by the charming village of  Kalekoy (Simena) , only accessible by boat or foot. It’s a peaceful, unforgettable way to connect with the region’s deep history. Bike ride through the scenic hills and coastline , where olive groves, ancient ruins, and panoramic sea views await at every turn. Whether you're cycling through peaceful villages or challenging yourself on mountain paths, it's a refreshing way to experience the natural beauty of the region. For a journey even further back in time, visit the ancient Lycian sites of  Letoon and Xanthos . These UNESCO World Heritage Sites are home to stunning temple ruins, grand theaters, and mysterious inscriptions. Walking among the stones, you’ll feel the echoes of civilizations that flourished thousands of years ago. To cool off, head inland to  Saklikent Gorge , one of the deepest canyons in Turkey. Walk through the icy mountain stream, splash through narrow passages carved by centuries of water, or just relax in one of the riverside cafes with your feet in the water. It’s the perfect spot to recharge and escape the summer heat. Cap off your Kas adventure with a  full-day boat trip along the coast . Sail to hidden bays, swim in secluded coves, and snorkel above vibrant underwater life. Enjoy a freshly prepared Turkish lunch onboard, bask in the sun, and let the rhythm of the waves carry your worries away. It’s the ultimate blend of leisure and exploration. title: 7 Churches of Revelation Tour
description: The Seven Churches Tour is an incredible journey through history, where ancient ruins meet profound spirituality. Walking through the remains of Ephesus , you’ll be awed by the grandeur of the Temple of Artemis and the lively ancient theater. In Smyrna , a modern city brimming with life, you can almost feel the echoes of early Christian saints, while the hills of Pergamum offer breathtaking views and an air of mystique, with ancient temples reaching for the sky. Thyatira and Sardis bring you closer to the heart of an ancient civilization, where remnants of once-great cities paint a vivid picture of life long ago. In Philadelphia , the stories of perseverance and faith linger, and Laodicea captivates with its stunning ruins, including the fascinating blend of Roman baths and theaters. Every step on this tour is an invitation to connect with both the past and the present—a harmonious blend of history, culture, and deep spiritual reflection. The Seven Churches Tour isn’t just about visiting ancient sites; it’s about walking in the footsteps of history , letting its stories resonate with your own. The tour typically includes: Ephesus – Famous for its well-preserved ruins, including the Temple of Artemis and the ancient theater. Smyrna (Izmir) – Known for its vibrant modern city and historical ruins, including ancient walls and a church dedicated to Saint Polycarp. Pergamum (Bergama) – Home to the Acropolis and the ancient Temple of Zeus, it has significant historical ruins. Thyatira (Akhisar) – Known for its ancient ruins, particularly the foundations of its old church. Sardis (Salihli) – Features remnants of an ancient city, including the Temple of Artemis and a large synagogue. Philadelphia (Alasehir) – Famous for its ruins, especially the church and a Byzantine-era fortress. Laodicea (Denizli) – Known for its ancient theaters, agoras, and hot springs.

Continue to Kadifekale (Velvet Castle), where you’ll be rewarded with panoramic views over the city and the Gulf of Izmir. Then visit the historic Church of Saint Polycarp, one of the oldest churches in the city, rich in history and religious significance. itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a scenic drive (approx. 2 hours) to Bergama, the site of the ancient city of Pergamum, one of the most powerful cultural centers of the Hellenistic world. Explore the magnificent Pergamon Acropolis, dramatically perched on a hilltop overlooking the valley below. Here, you will visit the impressive Theater of Pergamon, one of the steepest ancient theaters in the world, and the remains of the Temple of Zeus at Pergamon, once a grand sanctuary dedicated to the king of the gods. Continue to the remarkable Red Basilica, a massive Roman temple complex later converted into a Christian basilica, showcasing layers of religious history. After your visit, you may choose to stay overnight in Bergama for a more relaxed experience, or return to Izmir. Accommodation: Pier Passport Hotel or similar

itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Thyatira (approx. 1.5 hours), one of the ancient cities mentioned in the Book of Revelation. Explore the remains of the basilica and visit the small local museum, offering insight into the city's early Christian heritage. Continue your journey to Sardis (approx. 1 hour), once the capital of the ancient Lydian Kingdom and home of the legendary King Croesus. Here, you will visit the impressive Temple of Artemis at Sardis, the grand Sardis Gymnasium, and the beautifully restored Ancient Synagogue of Sardis, one of the largest synagogues of the ancient world. After the tour, continue to your hotel for an overnight stay in Salihli or Alasehir. Accommodation: Can Deluxe Hotel or similar

itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit Philadelphia, one of the Seven Churches of Revelation. Explore the remains of a Byzantine-era church and sections of the ancient fortress walls, offering a glimpse into the city’s enduring spiritual heritage. Continue your journey to Laodicea (approx. 2 hours), an important ancient city known for its wealth and significance in early Christianity. Discover its impressive ruins, including ancient theaters, agoras, and remarkably preserved early Christian structures. After the tour, drive to Pamukkale, famous for its stunning white travertine terraces and thermal waters. Overnight in Pamukkale, near the hot springs. Accommodation:  Venus Boutique Hotel or similar

After a short drive you will have a welcome cocktail in Ciragan Palace Kempinski hotel at 6:00 PM , where you’ll meet your tour guide and receive an overview of the journey ahead. The history of the Ciragan Palace is much older than expected, dating back to 17th century. In that century, the location of the Palace was famously known as the "Kazancioglu Gardens". It was an important location that was designated as an Imperial Garden, a Hasbahce , during the reign of . Sultan Ahmed I (r. 1603 - 1617) for the exclusive use of the sultan and his family. During the reign, Sultan Murad (r. 1623 - 1640) gifted the land to his daughter Kaya Sultan. It was then that the first imperial structure was built on the grounds. You will enjoy a traditional welcome dinner in Michelin recommended Dinner , where your guide will introduce you to some of the region’s most famous local dishes, including one of the finest specialties from Ottoman cuisine. title: Immersive South Eastern Turkey: Culinary & Cultural tour
description: Experience the timeless beauty and cultural depth of Turkey on this unforgettable 5-day journey . Ancient history, natural wonders, and delicious cuisines ... We don’t just show you destinations – we let you taste them. On our signature tours, history and food come together to create memories that last a lifetime. Begin your adventure in Istanbul , where East meets West, and explore the city’s most iconic landmarks — the majestic Topkapi Palace , the awe-inspiring Blue Mosque and the vibrant Grand Bazaar . Continue to Gaziantep famous with Baklava and kebabs, Sanliurfa , the cradle of civilization, to uncover the mysteries of the ancient world at Gobeklitepe — the world’s oldest known temple. Immerse yourself in history at the Sanliurfa Archaeological Museum and the Haleplibahce Mosaic Museum , home to exquisite Roman-era artworks. Your journey concludes with an ascent to Mount Nemrut , a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where colossal stone statues stand guard over the tomb of King Antiochus I . Witness one of the most spectacular sunsets in Turkey , a perfect finale to a tour that blends history, adventure, and breathtaking landscapes .

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old Town & Traditional Ottoman Tastes
itinerary.description: Welcome to Turkey! Your adventure begins in the captivating city of Istanbul, celebrated for its rich history and unique location straddling two continents. Meet your tour leader and fellow travelers at 1:00 pm for a welcome meeting in the hotel and trip briefing. After introductions, embark on a guided exploration of Istanbul’s enchanting Old Town. Visit the Topkapi Palace, the opulent residence of Ottoman sultans; admire the architectural splendor of the Blue Mosque; and stroll through the historic Hippodrome, once the heart of Byzantine civic life. Continue to the vibrant Grand Bazaar, one of the world’s oldest and largest covered markets, filled with colorful shops and local treasures. You will enjoy a traditional welcome dinner, where your guide will introduce you to some of the region’s most famous local dishes, including one of the finest specialties from Ottoman cuisine. Overnight in Istanbul Accommodation : Wyndham old Town or Similar

itinerary.title: Gaziantep & Famous Antep Baklava
itinerary.description: This Morning we fly to Gaziantep city where the most famous baklava invented. Visit the world-renowned  Zeugma Mosaic Museum , home to some of the most stunning Roman mosaics ever discovered, including the iconic “Gypsy Girl.” This museum offers a fascinating glimpse into the region’s ancient past. Wander through the charming alleys of the old bazaar area, including  Bakircilar Carsisi  (Coppersmith Bazaar), where you can watch artisans at work and shop for handcrafted souvenirs. For dinner, indulge in Gaziantep’s legendary cuisine at  Imam Cagdas , one of the most famous kebab restaurants in the country. Try local specialties such as  Ali Nazik kebab ,  lamb skewers , and freshly baked  lahmacun . Overnight in Gaziantep Accomodation : Hilton Garden inn or Similar

itinerary.title: Adiyaman & Local Family Lunch
itinerary.description: Enjoy a warm local family lunch in a village before continuing your journey to Mount Nemrut . In Adiyaman, you’ll experience authentic daily life as we visit a local Kurdish family in their home. Share a traditional meal, learn about their culture, and discover the stories behind their special dishes. Afterward, we drive to Mount Nemrut to see the giant stone heads and Watch the sun set over the colossal statues of this UNESCO World Heritage Site at 2,000 m.   Overnight in Adiyaman. Accommodation : Ramada by Wyndham Adiyaman or Similar

itinerary.title: Gobeklitepe Temple & Traditional Sira Gecesi Activity
itinerary.description: Explore  Gobeklitepe , the world’s oldest known temple complex and a UNESCO site. Visit the  Sanliurfa Archaeology Museum  and the  Mosaic Museum , home to the famous “Urfa Man” statue. Get ready this evening for enjoyable activity. Sira Gecesi  is a traditional social gathering from  Sanliurfa , combining  music, food, and friendship  into one unforgettable night. Overnight in sanliurfa Accommodation : Hilton Garden inn or similar

itinerary.title: Sanliurfa Old Town & Urfa Kebab Night
itinerary.description: Head to Karahantepe and Sogmatar, mysterious ancient settlements linked to early civilizations. Overnight in Sanliurfa. Visit the Sanliurfa Archaeology Museum and the Mosaic Museum, home to the famous “Urfa Man” statue. Today you will try Urfa Kebab – The iconic local kebab made from seasoned minced meat grilled over charcoal. Less spicy than some other regional kebabs but deeply flavorful. Enjoy your meal. Accommodation : Hilton Garden inn or similar

itinerary.title: Return Flight & The Tour Ends
itinerary.description: Today marks the final day of your journey. After breakfast, we’ll transfer you to  sanliurfa Airport  for your  domestic flight back to Istanbul . We aim to secure the  earliest available flight , but if morning flights are fully booked, you will be scheduled on the  next available afternoon departure . Thank you for visiting  Turkey  and for choosing to travel with   . It has been our pleasure to host you, and we hope to welcome you again on another unforgettable adventure in the future. Tour ends in the airport
